{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts lag behind price turning points, especially at market bottoms where true outcomes decline faster than predicted.",
    "When sentiment turns negative, model under-forecasts the decline as it over-relies on historical mean reversion to positive sentiment norms.",
    "Sentiment-based adjustments are ineffective during strong downtrends where buyer sentiment becomes irrelevant to actual price action.",
    "Model tends to overshoot current prices when moving from consolidation to volatility, failing to capture the gradual nature of price adjustments.",
    "Forecast volatility underestimates true outcome volatility by approximately 15-20% throughout the 30-day horizon.",
    "When price has been declining for 5+ consecutive days, model forecasts remain ~1-2 points too high compared to observable support levels.",
    "Sentiment alignment with price movement breaks down after 7+ days of unchanged price, causing forecast drift from fundamental support levels"
] }
